summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation to report a scheduled distribution on the Select Notes Trust LT 2003-4 Long Term Certificates. The filing provides details of the interest payment for the period from April 16, 2026 to May 15, 2026, totaling $165,937.50 or $3.245563 per certificate. There are no corporate actions, mergers, acquisitions, or special situations involved. The registrant explicitly disclaims participation in or verification of the underlying issuers' reporting. This is a standard periodic trust distribution report, not a special situation.
